summary: NVIDIA filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026, announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face, Inc., an open-source AI platform. The purchase price is approximately $11.9 billion payable to stockholders, plus up to $1.0 billion in equity-based retention for employees. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. NVIDIA committed to keeping Hugging Face's platform open and supporting other silicon vendors. Risks include potential government restrictions on open-source AI models. Watch for regulatory scrutiny and closing timeline updates.
